newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air October load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air October load factor up.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Thursday the October passenger load factor on its system scheduled service rose 2.3 points to 72.0 percent from 69.7 percent a year ago.
Available seat miles gained 5.7 percent 7.90 billion from 7.47 billion, and revenue passenger miles increased 9.2 percent to 5.69 billion from 5.21 billion.
Year to date, the carrier said its passenger load factor was 73.9 percent, up 1.7 points from 72.2 percent in 1995.
It said available seat miles were 78.68 billion, up 7.9 percent from 72.91 billion, and revenue passenger miles increased 10.4 percent to 58.14 billion from 52.65 billion.
